acceptance: The run socket lives in a directory that no agent can write
Linux refuses or denies the run socket
fix: Do (b) as the structural fix, add a bwrap rule or refusal for (a), give recipe sessions the unset for (c), and record (d) from the gate wave.
summary: Follow-ups from cycle 1853 (#836): (a) Linux bwrap has no run-socket deny when TMUX_TMPDIR is outside /tmp; (b) the bridge can put the run socket with -S in a directory that no agent profile can write, which removes the move/link attack class; (c) recipe sessions (newRecipeDriver) get neither the TMUX unset nor the sandbox; (d) the first live wave after #836 must show that claude and agy stop their own subprocesses under (allow signal (target same-sandbox)).
title: Tmux isolation: Linux has no run-socket deny, and the run socket sits in a directory that agents can write
